scenes.description: An adult shading their face from fierce midsummer sunlight on a bright exposed path, with visible heat shimmer above the ground. Dry hot glare and a sun beating down intensely, no injury.
Three panels show the same four people moving forward a short distance in a queue at a counter.
A tense person leans toward a closed door, hands clasped and one heel raised.
A browned piece of food sits in a shallow film of oil, with small bubbles gathering at its edge and a little vapor rising.
A mechanical twin bell has a central striker with repeated vibration arcs.
